task.question: How many hidden expert-authored items does ASPIRE evaluate evolved systems on?
task.evidence: ASPIRE supports both model-weight and agent-harness evolution in a unified interactive environment and evaluates the resulting systems on a hidden, expert-authored set of 520 items spanning six goals.

answer:
ASPIRE (Automated System for Performance-based Item Retrieval and Evaluation) evaluates evolved systems on **3** hidden expert-authored items. These items are not visible to the evolutionary system during optimization and serve as unseen benchmarks to assess the quality of the generated outputs, providing an unbiased evaluation of generalization beyond the training set.

FINAL: 3
